- Pre-Athletic Training Emphasis, B.S.","groupId":"6bb755ee-e019-4349-823e-01928d1244dd","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

ABOUT THE MAJOR

The pre-athletic training emphasis is specifically for individuals interested in attending a graduate program in athletic training. Athletic training programs are now offered nation-wide at the graduate level only. Students desiring to become athletic trainers must complete an undergraduate degree that meets specific pre-requisites for these graduate-level programs. This degree program and emphasis provides the ideal foundation for students pursuing athletic training.


EMPHASIS COURSES

Students in the Pre-Athletic Training Emphasis will complete at least 21 units of emphasis electives. See catalog for details.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
